question.text: Which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: Gluconic acid is a dicarboxylic acid
Gluconic acid is a partial oxidation product of glucose
Gluconic acid can form cyclic (acetal/hemiacetal) structure
Gluconic acid is obtained by oxidation of glucose with  <math><mtext>HN</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>O</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>

solution.text:
Here only B is correct and rest are incorrect. As Gluconic acid is a monocarboxylic acid which is formed by the partial oxidation of glucose.

As Gluconic acid can not form cyclic (acetal/hemiacetal) structure and oxidation of glucose with HNO3 gives Saccharic acid.
